representation: train mean subtract then L2 normalize; fail norm<1e-12
head: zero initialized384x7 softmax plus bias
selection: unsupported argmax always abstains; otherwise supported argmax accepted only above probability/margin thresholds
dev_selection: minimize wrong-known plus unsupported false accepts, maximize correct-known accepts, higher thresholds on tie
fresh_holdout: 36 independently authored matched EN/HI/GU rows, six supported and six unsupported scenario families; author blind to new train/dev
prior_cases: not used in training/dev or new holdout; previously inspected only
